viewer-store.description: SQLite persistence: schema DDL, versioned migration runner, ModelStore, ReadHandle, SnapshotTxn, FTS5 helper, kind registry seed. Imports viewer-core for shared types. Phase 3: gains embeddings table, upsertEmbedding, semanticSearch, embeddingCoverage. Phase 4: gains file_hashes table, schema_migrations table, upsertFileHash, loadFileHashes, getMigrationStatus, configurable PRAGMAs. Phase 5: gains busy_timeout PRAGMA (configurable via SqlitePragmaOpts.busyTimeout), deleteFtsForFile on SnapshotTxn for incremental FTS updates.

viewer-indexer.description: File discovery, tree-sitter extraction (TS, JSON, Python, Rust, Go, Java), TS language service adapter, import resolution, git history mining, subsystem inference, claim generation, partiality tracking. Phase 3: gains embedding computation via optional ONNX Runtime. Phase 4: gains worker-thread pool, incremental re-indexing, global symbol map, secret scrubbing, grammar checksums, verbose progress. Phase 5: gains Java visitor, picomatch for subsystem glob matching, comprehensive metadata scrubbing, path relativization, batch writer, incremental FTS, rename detection. Imports viewer-core, viewer-store.
